goal: Issue #386 slice S3 (Spec docs/specs/review-cli-stage.spec.md, D7, D8, D10). CLI dispatch becomes the default at all three composition roots; IMMUNE_BRAIN_REVIEW_DISPATCH=subagent remains as the rollback value until S4. drive.md, drive-batch.md, docs/reference/subagent-dispatch-protocol.md and the authority-review skill describe running review_command, review_profile_required and the release reasons; advisory, ui-review, QA and verifier sections are unchanged. New ADR 0037 partially supersedes ADR 0006, 0017 and 0030, which gain status notes.

acceptance.assertion: Spec S3 AC1 and BR-SCN-1 (BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-6; D8). Done looks like: with no switch, a configured project reviews through the CLI and names its profile. Seam: tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts describe 'default cli dispatch', driving the Claude composition root with IMMUNE_BRAIN_REVIEW_DISPATCH unset on a material task with project lanes {review_host: 'pi', review_model: 'model-x'}. Positive: review_ready carries review_profile {host: 'pi', model: 'model-x'} and exactly one review_command. Bound: with IMMUNE_BRAIN_REVIEW_DISPATCH=subagent the same task returns agent_params and no review_command.

Spec S3 AC2 and BR-SCN-2 (BR-REQ-5, BR-DEC-3; D7). Done looks like: with no switch and no profile, the drive stops with one recovery action. Seam: tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts describe 'default profile required', IMMUNE_BRAIN_REVIEW_DISPATCH unset, material task, no review_host. Negative: review_preparation_failed with code 'review_profile_required' and a single recovery_action containing 'lanes.review_host'. Bound: a routine task under the same configuration completes after QA.

Spec S3 AC3 (BR-REQ-1, BR-OUT-1, BR-OUT-5; D10). Done looks like: the drive contracts tell the Parent to run review_command instead of dispatching a reviewer subagent. Seam: tests/pi-subagent-dispatch-observability-contract.test.ts describe 'authority review cli contract' reading the real files, plus tests/dist-docs-sync-contract.test.ts. Positive: plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive.md and plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive-batch.md each contain 'review_command' and 'review_profile_required'; docs/reference/subagent-dispatch-protocol.md contains 'authority-review'. Negative: the authority Review parts of drive.md no longer contain 'immune-brain-reviewer' or 'subagent_type: "Review"'. Bound: the advisory and verifier sections of subagent-dispatch-protocol.md still name their subagent dispatch; packaged mirrors are byte-equal.

Spec S3 AC4 (BR-REQ-7; D10). Done looks like: the decision record exists and superseded ADRs point at it. Seam: the real files. docs/adr/0037-authority-review-cli-stage.md exists and names ADR 0006, 0017 and 0030; each of docs/adr/0006-unattended-review-dispatch-authority.md and the ADR 0017 and 0030 files contains '0037'.

scope_size_reason: Flipping the default changes the Review instructions every Host reads, so drive.md, drive-batch.md, the dispatch protocol reference, the skill and the ADR set must move together with the composition roots; about half of the paths are packaged doc mirrors, Antigravity runtime mirrors and the two generated MCP bundles.
